records.text: Mark Burnett became chairman of MGM, which owned Summer House, and Erika Kirk appeared on the program in 2019.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: wasn't Erika on a show randomly uh what's what's the show called Summer House in 2019 interestingly enough ... when Mark Burnett took over MGM became a chairperson of MGM they did acquire he was owned he owned summer house

verification.notes: Burnett became president of MGM Television in 2015 and chairman in 2018, and Erika Frantzve appeared on Summer House in 2019. But Summer House was produced by Truly Original for Bravo, not owned by MGM, so the composite claim contains a material false link.

records.text: Hollywood was factually started by Jewish gangs, including the people behind Universal and MGM.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Hollywood was, as we know, factually started by Jewish gangs. Universal, MGM, there's no hiding that, okay?

verification.notes: Jewish immigrants and Jewish executives played a major role in founding and running early Hollywood studios, including studios in the Universal and MGM lineages. Calling them gangs is unsupported and materially misleading.

sources.title: Inside the Academy Museum's Casablanca Exhibition | Academy
sources.relevance: Confirms that the heads of the founding Hollywood studios were predominantly Jewish while providing no support for the gang characterization.
